name: Lightcrest
caption: CEWF's own World Champion as of the fed's first surviving retrospective column, October 1994.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Intro' retrospective column (13 October 1994), answering a fan's own roster write-up.

name: "Flashy" Freddy Massey
caption: Won CEWF's Television Championship by outlasting a Battle Royal despite a poor win/loss record, then held it through numerous defenses before losing it to Al Andrewson.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Intro' retrospective column (13 October 1994), answering a fan's own roster write-up.

name: Al Andrewson
caption: One of the CEWF's original "Horsemen" stable, ended a month-long chase to finally beat Freddy Massey for the Television Championship.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Intro' retrospective column (13 October 1994), answering a fan's own roster write-up.

name: Roger DeCarnac
caption: Won the CEWF United States Championship from The Gravedigger and, as of the fed's own October 1994 retrospective, was working to regain it after putting it on the line for a World Title shot against Lightcrest.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Intro' retrospective column (13 October 1994), answering a fan's own roster write-up.

name: "Deadly" Dirk Venom
caption: Half of the "Bad Company" tag pairing; won the CEWF Battle Royal Championship during the fed's own European Tour angle and, per the fed's October 1994 retrospective, had the best lifetime win record of the fed's original wrestlers.

tenures.source: The fed's own 'Intro' retrospective column (13 October 1994), answering a fan's own roster write-up.
